entitymodel.title: Entity of Assets Component
entitymodel.description: Assets component extension entities. Core OFBiz master data remains authoritative; Assets* entities store only fixed-asset subledger and lifecycle gaps.

field.name: partyId
field.description: Company/legal entity party that owns this asset book. Use partyId to align with OFBiz PartyAcctgPreference.

field.name: roleTypeId
field.description: Role of partyId for this book, normally an internal organization/accounting owner role.

field.name: bookTypeEnumId
field.description: Corporate, tax, IFRS, management, or group book classification.

field.name: currencyUomId
field.description: Book currency. Defaults should be derived from PartyAcctgPreference.baseCurrencyUomId in services.

field.name: isPostingBook
field.description: If Y, schedules may post AcctgTrans entries. If N, schedule is memo/reporting only.

field.name: fixedAssetTypeId
field.description: Optional fixed asset type override. Use _NA_ in services when mapping applies to all types.

field.name: fixedAssetId
field.description: Optional fixed asset override. Use _NA_ in services when mapping applies to all assets.

field.name: partyId
field.description: Company/legal entity party for this mapping.

field.name: roleTypeId
field.description: Role for partyId in this mapping.

field.name: partyId
field.description: Company/legal entity party for the run.

field.name: roleTypeId
field.description: Role for partyId in the run.

field.name: partyId
field.description: Company/legal entity party for the request; requester/approver roles should use RequirementRole or AssetsApprovalDecision.

field.name: partyId
field.description: Company/legal entity party where this approval rule applies.

field.name: approverRoleTypeId
field.description: OFBiz RoleType expected to approve; concrete approver party is captured on AssetsApprovalDecision.

field.name: approverPartyId
field.description: Approver party. This entity has more than one party reference, so the field name includes the business role.

field.name: evaluatorPartyId
field.description: Evaluator party. This entity may reference supplier through Quote, so this explicit field captures the evaluator role only.

field.name: performedByPartyId
field.description: Party that performed or recorded the event. This entity has multiple optional references, so the business role is included in the field name.

field.name: fromPartyId
field.description: Source custodian/owner party. This entity has multiple party references, so field names include from/to roles.

field.name: lessorPartyId
field.description: Lessor party. This entity has multiple party references, so party fields include the business role.

field.name: providerPartyId
field.description: Service provider party for non-lease components such as insurance or driver.

field.name: insurerPartyId
field.description: Insurance provider party.

field.name: partyId
field.description: Driver party.

field.name: roleTypeId
field.description: Driver role type for partyId.

field.name: partyId
field.description: Company/legal entity party for the posting run.
